scope: AD103 RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (PCI 0x270510de). Classifies the tensor-core throttle signature from same-run ratios. Driver, CUDA runtime and benchmark-binary versions are recorded but deliberately NOT gating: every ratio is normalized to the same-run FP16-input/FP16-accumulate control, so absolute driver/clock differences cancel. This is a performance signature, not a live SS0/SS1 register read.
why_driver_agnostic: The locked state halves FP32-accumulate tensor throughput and FP8 relative to the FP16-accumulate control (a hardware selector effect, ~0.5x and ~1.0x); unlocked runs ~1.0x and ~2.0x. Measured identically on drivers 610.88, 621.14 and 621.24 across 5 boots (14 sessions, table below). The gap between the bands is >0.3 on every ratio.
